concepts.title: ACTIVATION PROCEDURE
concepts.description: Step-by-step activation procedure, prerequisites, CLI commands, rollout strategy, and post-activation verification for CQI-based UE energy efficiency enhancement.

concepts.title: DEACTIVATION PROCEDURE
concepts.description: Outlines the steps, CLI commands, traffic impact, and verification for deactivating CQI-Based UE Energy Efficiency Enhancement.

concepts.title: Feature Dependencies
concepts.description: Outlines feature, hardware, and network dependencies as well as operational limitations for CQI-Based UE Energy Efficiency Enhancement.

concepts.title: FEATURE OPERATION
concepts.description: Describes CQI filtering, UE classification into race-to-sleep or relaxed classes, scheduling behaviors, link adaptation back-off, and hysteresis mechanisms for CQI-based UE energy efficiency.

concepts.title: Feature Overview
concepts.description: Overview of CQI-Based UE Energy Efficiency Enhancement, detailing race-to-sleep scheduling compaction and low-CQI CSI configuration relaxation.

concepts.title: Network Impact
concepts.description: Details the impact of the CQI-Based UE Energy Efficiency Enhancement feature on end users, cell capacity, signaling, and network KPIs.

concepts.title: Parameters
concepts.description: Configuration parameters, value ranges, datatypes, and default settings for the CQI-Based UE Energy Efficiency Enhancement feature.

concepts.title: Performance Management
concepts.description: Monitors UE battery saving proxies, throughput impact, KPIs, and performance counters for CQI-based UE energy efficiency enhancement.
